text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Th-This late-stage burst is...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Not bad, Durandal.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* I did it... I managed to 
break through. But even so...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I felt like I was on the brink of death. 
If the timing of drawing the blade had 
been off by even a fraction—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The "Holy Sword" had nowhere left to turn, 
and I was buried away along with it. Is 
this...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The terror of sprints. The sheer dread of 
betting everything on a late burst in a 
1200m race...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fortune favored me today. But at a 1200m 
GⅠ, I likely wouldn't stand a chance...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Kh, how deeply... regrettable... Is 
this... as far as I go?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Believe-san, Light O-san, thank you for 
sparring with me."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Then... best of luck in the real thing.

Durandal bit her lip at the bleak outlook. 
I quietly watched over her.

"Aside from what Durandal thought, I also 
had my own thoughts as her Trainer."
choice_data_list:
It's not getting through... Right, it 
shouldn't get through

text_block_list.text:
Betting it all on a late burst in a 1,200m 
GⅠ. With Durandal's current ability, it 
probably won't work. However...
choice_data_list:
If our opponent is the same as this 
time...

text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O and Believe. When these 
two get together...
"A special situation arises. Namely—"

Calstone Light O surges ahead right from 
the start, reaching top speed in an 
instant. And then—

Believe maintains her blistering pace 
without easing up for a single moment. As 
a result...

The race is set to be 'ultra high-paced.' 
When that happens, the Umamusume running 
at the front of the pack will...

Running out of stamina, they completely 
collapse. Losing speed, they all slide 
back together. Which means, at the very 
end—

It creates a chance to cut them all down 
at once with the 'Holy Sword'!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King, I have returned. The outcome met 
the passing mark, but as for the internal 
circumstances...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I must say it's quite precarious. Perhaps 
for her next race, we should switch to the 
Mile..."

As a king, I haven't been able to make a 
single major decision for their sake up 
until now. Even so...

Today is the day I do it. To thank them 
for dedicating their sword to my immature 
self.
choice_data_list: Our next goal—isn't a mile race.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...? Then where to?
choice_data_list:
Onward to Nakayama like this. To the 
Eastern Front.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama...? The Eastern Front means... 
n-no way!
choice_data_list: Yeah, onward to the Sprinters Stakes!

Yeah, let's march on to the Sprinters 
Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"The Sprinters Stakes...! Are you saying I 
can do it?"
choice_data_list:
We can do it! With you two together today, 
we've got this!

text_block_list.text:
If Believe and Calstone Light O are both 
present, they might be able to put up a 
fight equal to today. Furthermore—

The razor-sharp timing of acceleration. If 
she can master that completely, she might 
just make it in the sprints going forward.
choice_data_list:
It's a gamble, but... are you with me on 
this?

It's a gamble, but... would you be okay 
with that?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"—My King, it goes without saying. I am 
your sword."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Just show me the battlefield, and I shall 
do your bidding. So long as you place your 
faith in me!

A sudden, dramatic decision. And just like 
that, the next goal was set.

Believe, onward to the Sprinters Stakes 
where Calstone Light O awaits. Stride 
proudly forward as the Classic Class's 
foremost knight.
